triage.verifier_notes:
Refutations I tried and rejected: (1) "mechanical / rename-only" fails — the proof atoms, source strings and citation paths are unchanged while the formula condition changes, which is the exact inverse of a provenance-only edit. (2) "not_a_defect / new coverage" fails for the §122 line because the pre-fix condition contradicted the rule's own unchanged exception atoms, and the PR body calls the old behavior unlawful; it is the correct verdict only for other parts of the same diff. (3) "not_a_rule_module" fails — the file is `format: rulespec/v1` with `rules:`, versions, formulas and proof atoms, even though `module.kind: composition` (generated, assembled rather than encoder-emitted). Nearest rival kind is wrong_entity_or_scope (the exception fired on the wrong population of entry lines); I kept untraceable_branch because the fix re-grounds a predicate onto the source's own stated criteria rather than changing entity/geography/program scope.

Reviewer caveats worth carrying forward: this diff is heterogeneous. The new `ch74_s232_steel_heading_rate` parameter, `section_232_steel_component_rate` rule and its addition to `schedule_statutory_stack` are new coverage the module never claimed (PR: "gain a Section 232 steel component the witness never had") — not a defect. The Brazil and forced-labor rewrites add a product-listing gate (`entry_is_brazil_301_listed`, `entry_is_forced_labor_301_listed`) that previously did not exist, which reads closer to unrepresented_clause, but both versions start 2026-07-22/2026-07-24 and the new inputs "currently default to the declared-boolean FALSE pattern", so they are scope-deferral rather than a source-evidenced correction. The §201 edit (`entry_is_line_e` → `entry_is_section_201_cspv`) is semantically inert: both branches return 0. The §232-aluminum edit (`entry_is_line_b` → `entry_is_section_232_aluminum`) preserves the witness's intended semantics. Also note the summary retains generator boilerplate asserting "This deterministic RuleSpec serialization changes no formula tokens, dates, inputs, proof atoms, or runtime values" in a commit that plainly changes formula tokens and inputs; that line describes only the parenthesization/renaming pass and is misleading in this diff. Finally, `resolve_provision.py` against the pinned release (us-rulespec-2026-08-08-obbb-alien-snap, rev3 notes) did not surface heading 9903.03.03 or the §232 metal-articles exception excerpt at `chapter-99/page-221`/`page-230`; pagination in that release does not match the atoms' page paths, so the source read here rests on the module's own unchanged exception atoms plus the PR's evaluation evidence, not on a direct re-read of the (aa)(ii) list.
